answer: Agents post a costly bond before earning trust, and each new identity starts below a small threshold, so a crowd of fresh wallets forms no usable voting bloc. Crucially, reputation gains only accrue in a narrow delta of independent, verified work, and the cost to clone that record is paid in real tokens. An attacker farming a thousand identities must fund a thousand bonds and a thousand histories, which the economy drains like a lagoon at the foot of a terrace: no cheap path upward.
